AlbumOut.description: A canonical album with its (metadata-only) track listing.
AlbumOut.title: AlbumOut

AlbumRefOut.description:
Album metadata as it appears nested inside a :class:`TrackOut`.

An ``AlbumRef``-like shape (no track listing) plus the canonical ``id`` so a
client can follow it to ``GET /albums/{id}``.
AlbumRefOut.title: AlbumRefOut

ArtistOut.description: A canonical artist with its (metadata-only) top tracks.
ArtistOut.title: ArtistOut

ConfigResponse.description: ``GET /config`` body: deployment mode, feature flags, matcher version.
ConfigResponse.title: ConfigResponse

CreatePatRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /auth/tokens``: mint a personal access token for the CLI.

``name`` is a required non-blank label (1–255 chars, matching the column
width). ``expires_in_days`` is optional — when omitted the PAT never expires
(``expires_at = NULL``); when given it must be a positive integer and the
router converts it to an absolute ``expires_at`` via the shared clock.
CreatePatRequest.title: CreatePatRequest

CreateReportRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /reports``: a metadata correction against a canonical entity.

``subject_type`` is a real :class:`~spotdl_core.model.EntityType` (an unknown
value is a 422 before the service runs); ``field`` / ``proposed_value`` /
``reason`` are all optional (a free-form report just carries a ``reason``).
CreateReportRequest.title: CreateReportRequest

EntityEnvelope.description: A resolved entity tagged by ``type``; exactly one payload field is set.
EntityEnvelope.title: EntityEnvelope

ErrorEnvelope.description: The single wire shape for every error response body.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

FeatureFlags.description: The per-mode feature switches surfaced to clients (spec §4).
FeatureFlags.title: FeatureFlags

LoginRequest.description: Body of ``POST /auth/login`` (no length policy — only register enforces it).
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

LyricsOut.description: One lyrics variant for a track (``GET /tracks/{id}/lyrics`` element).
LyricsOut.title: LyricsOut

LyricsResponse.description: ``GET /tracks/{id}/lyrics``: the track id + its lyrics variants.
LyricsResponse.title: LyricsResponse

MatchOut.description: One ranked audio target for a track (``GET /tracks/{id}/matches`` element).
MatchOut.title: MatchOut

MatchesResponse.description: ``GET /tracks/{id}/matches``: the track id + its ranked matches.
MatchesResponse.title: MatchesResponse

PatCreatedResponse.description:
``POST /auth/tokens`` body: the newly minted PAT, **including the secret**.

This is the only response that carries ``token`` (the full ``spdl_pat_``
secret); it is shown exactly once and never returned again — thereafter a
client sees only :class:`PatResponse` (prefix + metadata). The client must
store ``token`` now (e.g. the CLI writes it to its config).
PatCreatedResponse.title: PatCreatedResponse

PatResponse.description:
A personal access token as it appears in listings (``GET /auth/tokens``).

Built straight from the ``ApiToken`` ORM row via ``from_attributes``; the
router never names the ORM type. The secret and its ``token_hash`` are
intentionally absent — only the display ``token_prefix`` and metadata are
ever listable (the full token is shown once, on create).
PatResponse.title: PatResponse

PlaylistOut.description: A canonical playlist with its ordered (metadata-only) track listing.
PlaylistOut.title: PlaylistOut

RefreshRequest.description: Body of ``POST /auth/refresh`` and ``POST /auth/logout``: the opaque token.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RegisterRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /auth/register``.

``password`` policy (argon2id, so bcrypt's 72-byte trap does not apply — the
max only bounds hashing cost): 8–128 characters, enforced here so a weak or
abusively long password is rejected before it reaches the service.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

ReportResponse.description:
A metadata-correction report as returned by ``POST /reports`` / ``GET /reports/me``.

Built straight from the ``Report`` ORM row via ``from_attributes`` — the router
hands the service's ``Report`` to :meth:`model_validate`; it never names the
ORM type. The admin-only review fields (``reviewed_by`` / ``reviewed_at`` /
``review_note``) are intentionally absent from the reporter-facing shape.
ReportResponse.title: ReportResponse

ReportStatus.description: Minimal review state of a metadata-correction ``reports`` row.
ReportStatus.title: ReportStatus

ResolveRequest.description: Body of ``POST /resolve``: a URL, ``provider:type:id`` ref, or free text.
ResolveRequest.title: ResolveRequest

ResolveResponse.description: ``POST /resolve`` result: the tagged entity + the sources that degraded.
ResolveResponse.title: ResolveResponse

SearchResponse.description: ``GET /search`` result: a ranked track list + degraded sources.
SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse

SubmitMatchRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /tracks/{id}/matches``: the audio-target URL to submit.

A single non-blank URL string; core's ``parse`` validates its shape and the
submission service enforces that it names an audio-provider *track* (a 400
``unsupported_url`` / ``not_an_audio_target`` otherwise).
SubmitMatchRequest.title: SubmitMatchRequest

TokenResponse.description:
A minted session: the access JWT, the rotating refresh token, and profile.

``token_type`` is always ``"bearer"`` and ``expires_in`` is the access
token's remaining lifetime in seconds (``settings.access_token_ttl_seconds``),
so a client knows when to refresh without decoding the JWT.
TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse

TrackOut.description: A canonical track (metadata only; matches/lyrics are separate resources).
TrackOut.title: TrackOut

UserResponse.description:
The authenticated profile (``GET /auth/me`` body; nested in tokens).

Built straight from the ``User`` ORM row via ``from_attributes`` — the router
hands the service's ``User`` to :meth:`model_validate`; it never touches ORM
types by name. The password hash is intentionally absent.
UserResponse.title: UserResponse

VotableType.description:
Polymorphic discriminator for ``votes.votable_type``.

Values are the string form of the target table: ``votable_id`` points into
``matches.id`` / ``lyrics.id`` / ``entity_links.id`` respectively (no
cross-table FK).
VotableType.title: VotableType

VoteRequest.description:
Body of the vote endpoints: ``up`` (+1), ``down`` (-1), or ``retract``.

A closed ``Literal`` so anything else is a 422 before the service runs — the
only three verbs the state machine accepts.
VoteRequest.title: VoteRequest

VoteResponse.description:
The vote outcome: the votable's fresh tallies, derived status, and the
caller's own vote (``+1`` / ``-1`` / ``null`` after a retract).

Mirrors the service's :class:`~spotdl_server.services.voting.VoteOutcome`;
``status`` is ``null`` for lyrics (which have no status column).
VoteResponse.title: VoteResponse

Create an account (no email verification in v1) and issue its first tokens.

delete.description: Revoke one of the caller's PATs (404 if it is not theirs / does not exist).

Liveness probe — always ``ok`` once the app is serving.

Up/down/retract a vote on a lyrics variant (lyrics have no status).
Up/down/retract a vote on a match; returns the fresh tallies + status.
File a metadata-correction report against a canonical entity (201, ``pending``).

schema.title: Response List My Reports Api V1 Reports Me Get
